messages:
Maya S (Sales): heads-up — prospect Boltly just asked if we can support a dedicated pool for their chat/embedding mix. They want predictable latency for chat (p95 < 120ms token) at 100 concurrent sessions and embeddings throughput of ~1200 qps during business hours. They also want a burst to 2x for promo events. Can product/eng confirm feasibility and what sizing + SLAs look like?
Sam H (PM): thanks Maya. Can you share ideal commit term and whether they expect reserved + burst billing? need that to define launch criteria.
Maya S (Sales): they prefer annual commit but open to pilot monthly. willing to pay for burst as metered add-on. customer is sensitive to cost, asks for cost estimate and fallback behavior if burst capacity exhausted.
Ryan Z (Eng-Platform): initial thought: for the chat workload p95 <120ms we should serve on rtx-a100-equivalent with small sequence optimizations. 100 concurrent sessions ~ steady-state token/sec depends on average message length; assuming 40 tokens/resp and ~2 turns/min => ~13k tokens/sec. embeddings 1200 qps with ada-embedding size -> typically CPU/offload pattern but they want GPU for latency. Ballpark we need a pool of 6-8 GPUs for steady state, with autoscale headroom to 12 for 2x burst.
Elena P (Solutions): customer also said 99.9% availability desire. We need clear rollout: pilot with 2-week canary at lower concurrency, SLA doc, and runbook for graceful degradation (route to hosted smaller model or increase batch sizes).
Sam H (PM): launch criteria draft: 1) capacity validated under 100 concurrent chat + 1200 qps embeddings in staging; 2) cost/per-token estimate agreed; 3) fallback policy tested (model downgrade or queueing) and customer acceptance; 4) alerting & tracing configured for tokens, tail-latency, and queue lengths.
Maya S (Sales): customer expects latency + cost numbers by EOD Friday. can we produce a quick SLO/cost estimate?
Ryan Z (Eng-Platform): I'll run a quick simulation today. need assumptions: avg tokens/resp, tokenizer batch effects, kv-cache hit rates. can @Maya attach sample traffic shape?
Maya S (Sales): attaching sample traffic in thread (sent separately).
capacity-bot: capacity-estimate-run triggered by Ryan Z — job id 2026-03-boltly-001. ETA ~ 6h.
Ryan Z (Eng-Platform): quick back-of-envelope (w/ assumed 40 tok/resp, 2 turns/min): chat ~13k tok/s, embeddings 1200 qps ~= 1200 tok/s (embedding ops count as 1 qps). total ~14.2k tok/s. With our per-GPU sustained token rate at that seq length ~1.6k tok/s => ~9 GPUs. add 25% headroom -> 12 GPUs for 2x burst.
Elena P (Solutions): notes for scope negotiation: we should propose a pilot at 4 GPUs with strict routing (embeddings to dedicated smaller fleet) to reduce cost initially. Offer formal dedicated plan with optional burst up to 12 GPUs billed at premium. Also include canary criteria: <10% error budget in 48h and p95 latency within 1.25x target.
Sam H (PM): agree. action items: Ryan to validate sim and provide a 3-tier proposal (pilot, committed, committed+burst) with cost and rollback plan. Elena to draft fallback pages and SLO language. Maya to negotiate term with customer and share traffic samples. I'll own sign-off checklist.
Maya S (Sales): thanks — I'll update Boltly and push for traffic samples now.
Ryan Z (Eng-Platform): starting sim now, will post results + assumptions in thread.
Elena P (Solutions): tagging for post-launch ops: eng-oncall + support runbook and latency dashboards.
Sam H (PM): ok. if we have sim numbers by EOD we can put a prioritized product ticket for dedicated provisioning + burst policy + SLA docs.
Maya S (Sales): :thumbsup:
